title: static-check.py mangled: broken shebang, exec bit dropped, comments whitespace-damaged
evidence:
-#!/usr/bin/env python3
+#!/ usr / bin / env python3

old mode 100755
new mode 100644

-    # 5. CRLF scan on tracked text files (best-effort: git tracked only)
+# 5. CRLF scan on tracked text files(best - effort : git tracked only)
detail: Whitespace damage rides the intentional bUseFixedFrameRate flip: shebang corrupted, execute bit dropped, comment indentation destroyed. Direct ./scripts/static-check.py execution breaks; only the python3-prefixed gate invocation survives.
recommended_fix: Restore the shebang, chmod +x, and comment formatting; keep only the bUseFixedFrameRate==false change. Do not run the C++ formatter over Python files.

title: compare-golden.sh --self-test: unchecked corruption step can false-pass
evidence:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
doc = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
doc['state_hash'] = '0000000000000000'
doc['flow_summary']['score'] = 999
json.dump(doc, open(sys.argv[2], 'w'))
" "$GOLDEN" "$TMP/corrupt.json"
  if compare "$TMP/corrupt.json" "$TMP/standalone.json" "self-test corrupted golden" >"$TMP/selftest.out" 2>&1; then

(contrast, the step right above IS guarded):
  ./tests/build/spine-check --json > "$TMP/standalone.json" 2>/dev/null || {
    echo "self-test: spine-check --json failed" >&2
    exit 1
  }
detail: The corruption step's exit status is unchecked. If the python fails (e.g. a stale v1 golden lacking flow_summary), corrupt.json never exists; compare fails on the missing file, prints GOLDEN MISMATCH, and the self-test reports OK.
recommended_fix: Guard the corruption step like the spine-check step above it: append || { echo "self-test: corrupt step failed" >&2; exit 1; }

title: Driver hash-equality test uses identical deltas — proves determinism, not float exclusion
detail: Both drivers receive the identical delta (0.05f), so any deterministic sim passes — even one leaking floats into state. The claimed ODN-10 float-exclusion property is never actually exercised.
recommended_fix: Reach the same tick via different float decompositions (e.g. 0.01f then 0.045f vs one 0.05f call) and assert the resulting state hashes still match.

title: Input binding leg tests a re-created binding, not the controller's SetupInputComponent
detail: The binding leg dispatches through a test-authored binding (fresh EIC + *ForTest handlers); the controller's own SetupInputComponent binding is never exercised. A production-binding regression (wrong action or trigger event) still passes.
recommended_fix: Also drive the controller's real binding path — e.g. a seam running its SetupInputComponent against an injected InputComponent — and assert the bound actions and trigger events.
